description: Claude Code against the local Qwen3.6 model. Same settings as the claude-local alias in ~/.zshrc.
startHint: Start the model and the proxy first: start-qwen.sh and start-proxy.sh.
restartHint: The proxy is running but the model server behind it failed. Look at the terminal running start-qwen.sh. If it says 'Insufficient Memory' (out of GPU memory), the model cannot handle an agent-sized prompt as configured: see README.md section 1, 'Running on the local model', for the memory settings. Otherwise stop start-qwen.sh, start it again, and run this command again.
